brief: Declares one named, typed capability of a flow, with a deterministic floor, optional model implementations and a golden set.
detail: A faculty says what is done (a payload type in, a payload type out) and never which model does it, so an implementation can be swapped, or dropped to the floor, without touching the flow. Every faculty needs a floor, a plain function that always answers; a model is chosen only when it strictly beats the floor on the faculty's golden set. Every answer is judged by a court for its output type before it leaves, and an answer the court refuses comes back as a refusal and not as a value. The definition is kept in one process-wide table and the object is only a handle on its row, so copies of it agree. Scores, goldens and certainties are computed by the class from what the implementations state; no person has judged the quality of any model output.
example: #--> faculty 'position': text -> number; implementations: last (floor); golden set v1 of 0 item(s)
#--> [ "no golden set: no model may be auto-selected without one" ]
